description: Überschwemmungsgebiete is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltkarten.lung-mv.de. Pursuant to Section 76(2) of the Water Management Act (WHG), the Land Government may establish water protection areas by means of an ordinance. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2020-12-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
